column4: Securities and Exchange Commission of
Sri Lanka

(ii)
to acts or omissions occurring outside Sri Lanka
in relation to securities of any listed corporate
entity or any other entity which is established
or is carrying on business within Sri Lanka that
has  made  a  public  offer  of  securities  in

or

(iii)
to  acts  or  omissions  occurring  in  relation  to
any  securities  issued  by  any  Government
outside Sri Lanka which are traded using the
facilities  of  an  exchange  licensed  by  the
Commission; and
in respect of derivatives-

(i)
to acts occurring within Sri Lanka in relation
to derivatives, traded on an exchange licensed
by the Commission; and

(ii)
to acts occurring outside Sri Lanka in relation
to derivatives traded on an exchange licensed
by the Commission.
